# Deju Studio

> Deju Studio is an ultra-premium private nail studio in Ubud, Bali, founded and operated by nail artist Desty Zulfa Nabila. The studio specialises in Russian manicure technique, structured gel and BIAB, soft tip / Gel-X / polygel / sculpture extensions, and hand-painted luxury nail art from minimalist to 4D. Bookings are by WhatsApp only.

## About

- Location: Jl. Tirta Tawar, Petulu, Ubud, Bali 80571, Indonesia
- Hours: Sunday to Friday, by appointment. Saturday closed.
- Booking: WhatsApp +62 823 4088 9808
- Instagram: @dejustudio
- Languages: English
- Price range: 50,000 to 700,000+ IDR per service
- Payment: Cash, card, bank transfer, QRIS

## Services and indicative pricing (IDR)

- Manicure (Russian) - 150,000
- Spa manicure - 200,000
- Gel manicure - 250,000
- Hard gel manicure - 300,000
- BIAB manicure - 400,000
- Pedicure - 200,000
- Spa pedicure - 250,000
- Gel pedicure - 300,000
- BIAB pedicure - 450,000
- Soft tip / Gel-X extensions - 400,000
- Tip overlay - 450,000
- Polygel - 500,000
- Sculpture extensions - 600,000
- Nail art Lv. 1 - 200,000
- Nail art Lv. 2 - 300,000
- Nail art Lv. 3 - 400,000
- Nail art Lv. 4 - 500,000
- Nail art Lv. 5 (4D) - 700,000
- Gel removal - 100,000 to 150,000
- Callus removal - 100,000
- Nail repair - 50,000
- Reusable press-ons - from 150,000

## Specialisations

- Russian manicure (advanced cuticle technique for the cleanest cuticle line)
- Structured gel and BIAB (Builder In A Bottle) for the longest wear
- Soft tip / Gel-X, polygel, and sculpture extensions
- Hand-painted luxury nail art (basic to 4D)
- Nail correction and safe removal
- Nail health assessment
